statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail remains in the low band while macro, geopolitical and FOMC stress remain extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH; the main conditional checkpoints are the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster, the cash open and the multi-stage FOMC sequence.
headline: Tail remains low as European trading begins with conflicted cross-asset evidence ahead of the FOMC
body: Fresh evidence is mixed rather than one-way: U.S. equity futures are modestly firmer, the 10-year yield has eased below 5%, Brent is near $108, and fresh Finviz context shows weak megacaps but stronger semiconductors. Direct live NQ retracement structure is not independently verified, so Tail remains low.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail ranged from 17% to 23%. WATCH covered much of the September 15 pre-open and U.S. session while Stress rose from 95% to 99%; Tail returned to the low band after 20:00 UTC and stayed low overnight.
outlookSummary: Conditional Tail stays low through most of the European morning, rises to WATCH around the 12:30 UTC U.S. data and cash open, and peaks at 24% during the 17:45-20:15 UTC FOMC danger window. A higher band requires observed persistent one-way structure, failed retracements or a credible delayed second leg.
